name: claudeconnect
notes: A ChatGPT template: setup asks whether to start from it, and it names your site ChatGPT and gives it ChatGPT's icon in the browser tab. Your own name and icon are still the default.

You can switch to the template at any time in Settings → Appearance, after confirming. It shows "In use" while your site still has its name and icon. Your chats and working folder stay as they are, and the command on your computer follows the name.

A new site now works in the Claude folder in your home folder (~/Claude) when you have one, whatever the site is called, instead of a new folder named after the site. Setting up again keeps the working folder you already have.
Renaming the site in Settings now changes the name at the top of the sidebar straight away, without reloading the page.
